$comment: Technology capability evaluation cases (Steps 20–23, D-039..D-042). Positive cases: the request should route to expect.skill, load expect.loads (skill-relative), and apply the section for expect.applies. Negative cases: the capability in expect.not_applies must not be applied; expect.skill is the better fit or none; expect.not_loads, when present, must not be read. context describes the fixture repository the case assumes. Checks are observable behaviour assertions for a human or model grader. Validated by tools/catalog/check-technology.mjs (V-23). Never shipped.
